items.title: Iola Brubeck interviewed by Monk Rowe, Wilton, CT, July 17, 2011
items.q: When we had finished recording “The Real Ambassadors” in the 30th Street Studios, he signed “Summer Song” and wrote across it, “Mrs. Brubeck” because he was very formal with me

ctx.x: They’re marvelous, and there is so much symbolism and imagery and the lyric.

Oh well thank you. He loved that song, Louis did. When we had finished recording “The Real Ambassadors” in the 30th Street Studios, he signed “Summer Song” and wrote across it, “Mrs. Brubeck” because he was very formal with me, “Mrs. Brubeck, I am very happy, Satchmo.”
That’s wonderful. And probably mounting this co-production, trying to get it on Broadway, I can’t imagine the hoops that you’d have to.
